title: Guided reading: Ephesians 2:8
subtitle: Track a prepositional phrase and article–noun agreement.
overview: This line includes a perfect passive construction you will study later. Today, track τῇ χάριτι, διὰ πίστεως, and the genitive phrase θεοῦ.
Separate what you can parse now from forms you will revisit; that is disciplined theological reading.

items.grc: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως.
items.en: For by grace you have been saved through faith.

items.grc: καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν, θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον.
items.en: And this is not from you; it is the gift of God.
